title: Same Release. Different Rollouts. Different Risk.

intro.before: Shipping code is a choice of
intro.after: first, and how fast you can take it back.

tiles.title: Recreate
tiles.good: Simplest: two versions never run side by side, so no compatibility work
tiles.watch: Users see downtime between stopping v1 and v2 becoming ready

tiles.title: Rolling Update
tiles.good: Kubernetes Deployment default: maxSurge and maxUnavailable at 25%
tiles.watch: v1 and v2 serve traffic together, so both must accept the same data

tiles.title: Blue-Green
tiles.good: Instant rollback: point the router back at the old environment
tiles.watch: Needs double capacity while both environments are running

tiles.title: Canary Release
tiles.good: Real users try v2 at 5% while you watch errors and latency
tiles.watch: Slow to reach 100%, and only safe if metrics catch regressions

tiles.title: Shadow (Mirroring)
tiles.good: Tests v2 on real production load with zero impact on users
tiles.watch: Mirrored writes, payments or emails must be stubbed out in v2

tiles.title: A/B Testing
tiles.good: Measures business impact per version: conversion, retention, revenue
tiles.watch: Needs enough traffic and time for a statistically significant result

tiles.title: Feature Flags
tiles.good: Decouples deploy from release; turn a feature off without a redeploy
tiles.watch: Old flags pile up as tech debt; delete each one after full rollout

tiles.title: Ring Deployment
tiles.good: Staff and opt-in users meet the bugs before the general public does
tiles.watch: Each ring needs its own audience and a waiting period before the next

rows.q: Risky change, test on real users
Load-test v2 with zero user risk

principles.sub: A strategy is only as safe as the time it takes to get back to the old version.
Canaries and rings help only if dashboards and alerts catch a bad version early.
Ship code dark, then turn it on per user, region or percentage.

quote.big: Deploys are routine. Releases are decisions.
quote.small: Choose how much traffic each version gets.
